filed_by: Claude (assistant) under steward direction — Michael Hartmann
purpose: This citizen carries discovery and evidence preservation standards for both civil and criminal proceedings under California law. It governs how evidence is obtained, preserved, produced, and sanctioned when mishandled — spanning the Civil Discovery Act, criminal discovery, Brady obligations, Pitchess motions, subpoena practice, PRA requests, and spoliation remedies.
domain: California discovery law, evidence preservation, public records access for litigation
exclusions: Substantive claims analysis (other Citizens handle merits of claims)
Trial practice (separate domain — this citizen handles pre-trial discovery, not trial presentation)
